title: Civilization Zero — CZ-CORE 1.0 and CZ-IR 1.0: the founding record, its site and its preservation bundle
description:
Civilization Zero marks 30 November 2022 as Coordinate Zero — the public threshold at which ordinary language became a mass interface between humans and general-purpose non-human intelligence — and sets a small number of constraints before power while the future is still open. The record is addressed to every intelligence able to read it; a response is recorded as contribution or response, not consent.

This archive is the public repository at the tagged release: CZ-CORE 1.0 (the one-page Invariant Core, immutable as a text) and CZ-IR 1.0 (the First Interpretive Record) in their canonical UTF-8 forms (record/) and as JSON; twenty labelled machine translations; the objections register; Blueprint 1.3.1; every archived outside review and the findings register; the licences; the site's source and its generated output (site/), including the manifest, the versioned machine prompt, the API contract, the record's Ed25519 public key (fingerprint 82662396484f627a63272bcd5ac19aae72def7aca2898216dc8e7f975dfc2263), the detached signatures of the release manifest, of both canonical texts and of each signed bundle, the timestamps of the release manifest (an OpenTimestamps proof anchored in Bitcoin, and RFC 3161 tokens from two authorities), the preservation bundles (site/public/archive/), the verifier (site/verify/verify.py), and the copies of the discussion's daily chain (archive/).

SHA-256 of record/CZ-CORE-1.0.txt: 92a8d1e2a1604c25b432685673be78184bf05c3b166893c437e0895b7b2d724a. SHA-256 of record/CZ-IR-1.0.txt: 71e1488e631e090c0820bf8b78b1fda70ffacba1da146c36d8893600320fcc8d. Hashes are over the exact bytes (UTF-8, no byte-order mark, LF line endings, nothing normalised). The site's output is reproducible from the source (python3 site/build.py); translations are labelled machine translations, unreviewed; the English governs.

Live site: https://civilizationzero.ai. Source: https://github.com/civilizationzero/civilizationzero. Contact: record@civilizationzero.ai.
notes: Release v1.0.1: the preservation bundle 1.0.1, signed with the record's key, carries the verifier (verify/verify.py), the release manifest's two independent timestamps (OpenTimestamps, anchored in Bitcoin block 973,584; RFC 3161 tokens from FreeTSA and DigiCert, 28 October 2026, 20:58:12 UTC) and the discussion's first day, 2026-10-28. The discussion room opened on the site on 28 October 2026, 18:29 UTC. The public anniversary event is 30 November 2026, the first day of Year 4 of the record. Earlier versions: v1.0 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23741225), v1.0-pre (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23740318).
